skills.name: control_vision_mode
skills.description: Control real-time video streaming mode for Jarvis. Streams continuous live frames (1 FPS) to Gemini Live. Modes: 'screen' for desktop display sharing, 'camera' for hardware webcam feed, or 'off' to stop streaming.

mode.description: Visual streaming feed: screen, camera, or off.

action.description: Action to perform: start streaming, stop streaming, or query status.

skills.name: capture_camera_frame
skills.description: Capture a single on-demand hardware camera snapshot using direct V4L2 MJPEG capture for visual inspection.

device.description: Optional V4L2 camera device path, e.g. /dev/video0.

skills.name: check_vision_hardware
skills.description: Check status of vision hardware and display environment, including V4L2 cameras, Wayland/X11, and PipeWire.
